title: Some effective
text: Some effective. My overall review after using all of them is that, yes it does work, but not all of them. For some reason the first 2-3 pouches worked pretty well but the last couple pouches the water formed at the top and it did not work as well as from the start. I would purchase this again and hopefully the next batch will be better.

product_metadata.title: Vacplus Moisture Absorber Packets, Fragrance Free(5 Pack), Humidity Packs, Dessicant Packets, Hanging Closet Dehumidifier Bags, Moisture Absorb 9.8OZ
features: 【EFFECTIVE ABSORBING】Vacplus dehumidifier bags use Spherical calcium chloride to enlarge the area to absorb quickly. One-way moisture permeable paper absorbs effectively. 500 ml/pack large capacity moisture absorption keep dry for a long time.

【VISIBLE EFFECT】The moisture is contained in a little plastic bag at the bottom. What amazing is that you can see the water added day by day, and really see the effectiveness. Vacplus create a dry and comfortable indoor environment.

【EASY & SAFE】Vacplus moisture absorber packets provide an easy solution to protecting items and fabrics from excess moisture. By Hanging them up, physical dehumidification gives you a Safe, Green & Energy-saving life.
【COMPACT DESIGN 】Vacplus hanging packets are designed to hang in closets and other closed spaces, ideal for us in bathrooms, basements, closets, laundry rooms , refrigerator, RV, ship, etc.

【HOW THEY WORK】Calcium chloride particles combine with moisture in the air and once they become completely solidified the particles will dissolve and the solution will flow into water reservoir. Please be patient for the process, it may take some time.
